paragraphs: Proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python (FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI) for a Madrid-based product start-up client, presented in a live stakeholder demo. This involved developing a scalable solution that improved the efficiency of our client's workflow by about 65 tests.

Built NLP and agentic RAG workflows with Hugging Face Transformers, Ollama, LangChain and LangGraph. This project enhanced our ability to process and generate natural language responses, significantly improving the accuracy of our chatbot interactions.
